items.text: Really tough projection on Jonathan Taylor today. If trading him, makes zero sense to play him. Report says expected to start.
items.implication: High risk start; possible limited or held if deal imminent.
items.opportunity: Full carries if plays; sit if trade noise peaks

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore (shoulder), who missed past two games, is expected to play today vs Ravens.
items.why: Shoulder aggravated earlier; Schefter confirmation Sunday morning.
items.implication: Moore returns with upside but re-injury risk; WR2/3 range.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) is not expected to play today vs Raiders; Braelon Allen slated to start again with workhorse role.
items.why: Quad injury, limited practice, Rapoport clarification after Allen start report.
items.implication: Allen becomes must-start RB2 vs soft Raiders run D.

items.text: Broncos officially placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR after knee injury in Thursday practice; misses at least 4 games.
items.why: Knee from practice; procedural IR move.
items.implication: Out ROS short-term; Dobbins/Coleman lead backfield.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for Dobbins and Coleman

items.text: Breece Hall not expected; Braelon Allen rides again as a solid RB2.
items.why: Hall news locks Allen into featured role.

items.text: OUT: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson (plus others). Part of comprehensive weekend fantasy injury summary.
items.why: ETR board lists them firmly OUT.

items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Jadarian Price, Zach Charbonnet, George Pickens, Jaylen Waddle, Colston Loveland, Jakobi Meyers, Kenny Gainwell, Calvin Ridley, others. OUT includes Egbuka/Tate context from prior.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday board from weekend reports.
items.implication: Clear starts for listed expected; sit confirmed OUTs like Egbuka/Tate.
items.opportunity: Price/Charbonnet SEA backfield shares; Loveland TE upside

items.text: Prior board and notes confirm Emeka Egbuka and Carnell Tate among OUTs; fallout for teammates.
items.implication: Sit both; TB/TEN WR depth benefits.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Godwin etc in TB; TEN WRs

items.text: Colts having active discussions; now open to dealing star RB Jonathan Taylor. Seeking CMC-like package.
items.why: Sources (w/ Schefter): open to trade ahead of deadline.
items.implication: Short-term start uncertainty if deal close; long-term value shift.
items.opportunity: If stays, full role; monitor for any sit

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley not being traded before deadline; ends speculation. He is playing (no final IR designation).
items.why: Sources confirm no trade; not on injury report despite prior hamstring/back.
items.opportunity: Full role expected though not 100% healthy

items.text: Cowboys WR George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring), listed Q, is expected to play vs Cardinals.
items.why: Limited all week but HC said he'd play; Schefter Sunday.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle (chest), listed Q, is trending toward playing vs Chiefs.
items.implication: Waddle likely active; monitor warmups for full role.

items.text: RJ Harvey's (knee) role is so unique, don't think he has a clean replacement. But 3-6 more targets now available. Also Waddle Q.
items.implication: Free targets in DEN offense; Dobbins primary but volume shared.
items.opportunity: 3-6 targets free; check Coleman/Dobbins snap shares

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring, back) wasn't on final injury report. Hard to believe he's 100%, but he's playing.
items.implication: Play him but expect possible limitation or lower efficiency.
items.conflict: Berry prior hate notes vs usage

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) isn't on final report, but we do have some smallish docks on his rushing.
items.why: Clean report post-ankle; projections docked slightly for rush.
items.implication: Start Lamar but slightly lower ceiling on ground.
items.opportunity: Passing volume intact; rush yards tempered

items.text: Weird one on Jakobi Meyers (hamstring, ankle). Comes out of bye LP-LP-DNP. Given that and BTJ situation, perhaps a season-high in routes for Travis Hunter?
items.why: Meyers practice oddity + BTJ; later confirmed good to go but routes note stands.
items.implication: Hunter route upside even if Meyers plays.
